entry.prerequisite: Completing Wudu with Idris via the live lesson sets wudu_learned and reveals the action.

asserted.scene_copy: Both production scenes render the locked title, kicker, dialogue and sole choice. The design reference stays out of the player-facing text.
asserted.effects: Both choices leave town trust, coins, the clock, public accounts and private counters unchanged.
asserted.completion: The action stays hidden on completion, the next day and after save restoration. Both lesson flags persist.
asserted.journal: Chapter progress, side totals and lifetime goals stay unchanged. Existing goals remain visible.

presentation: The Godot runner uses its compact secondary choice. Both masters show a full-width amber choice. Q15 assigns visual comparison to the design chat.
